facts.fact: CIPESA reports that Uganda's Data Protection and Privacy Act was applied by the Personal Data Protection Office in a decision of 18 July 2025.
CIPESA reports that the Personal Data Protection Office was acting as the regulator under the Act on 18 July 2025.
CIPESA reports that on 18 July 2025 the Office ruled against Google LLC, finding it in breach and ordering registration within 30 days.
